{{Top|leg}}
A '''Poisoner's Ring''',<ref name="DA">''[[Desperate Allies]]''</ref> or '''poison ring''',<ref name="WEG">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref> were a type of [[Ring/Legends|ring]] worn by politicians and [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]]<ref name="DA" /> that contained [[Poison/Legends|poison]].<ref name="WEG" />

Produced by a wide variety of artisans, a poisoner's ring was any ring that outwardly appeared as a common piece of jewelry, but was capable of delivering a dose of [[Poison/Legends|poison]]. By hollowing out the largest feature on the ring (perhaps a jewel, or [[Signet ring/Legends|signet]] face), the resulting cavity could hold a dose of poison; by means of a painstakingly crafted hinge, the wearer could use specific hand motions to access the space within.<ref name="DA" />

With practice, the wearer could deposit the the fatal cargo into a cut or bowl with little chance of being noticed.<ref name="DA" /> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] [[Dixton]] wore a poison ring.<ref name="WEG" />
